title: Document evidence and exact answer
goal: Locate the requested evidence and return its smallest complete answer span
guidance:
Answer from the document image. First locate the requested relation, then select its answer span, then transcribe it.

Match the question to field labels, spatial cues, or the table's row, column and period. For comparisons, compare the requested measure across the eligible entries. Distinguish the requested person, organization or value from neighboring roles and headings.

Select the smallest complete span that answers the question. Include every requested component and the words needed to identify the entity; exclude adjacent departments, addresses, explanations and unrelated fields. Preserve a complete requested title or category. Do not expand abbreviations, paraphrase, or substitute a familiar name.

Copy the selected digits, signs, precision and internal punctuation. Do not add decimal zeros, spaces inside identifiers, or units found only in a heading. Return only a requested date component when specified. Use ordinary straight ASCII quotation marks and apostrophes for textual transcription; preserve their presence and placement without adding quotes around unquoted text.

For ambiguous characters, distinguish their strokes from printed rules and nearby text in the same field. Inspect only when that uncertainty affects the answer. A clear, uniquely matched reading needs no additional verification. Return only the answer inside <answer>...</answer>.
